agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has 2 circles and a thin vertical wall. Body 1 (m~4.9, vx~27.7) falls/bounces then collides with stationary body 0 near x=16 at step 26-27. The impulse transfers excessive horizontal velocity to body 0 (vx ~30.64 at step 27, speed ~30.6). With dt~0.017 and 17-18 substeps, per-substep travel (~0.03) is small but the boundary collision at x=20 fails to prevent escape: by step 33 body 0 centre reaches x~19.45, so centre+radius ~20.25 exceeds arena limit by 0.25 (>0.15 tolerance). Reducing the impactor speed removes the high post-collision velocity and removes the violation, confirming high-speed body-body momentum transfer plus missed/insufficient arena boundary response as cause.
